# BeerPong simulation assets

MJCF and its referenced WAM/cup meshes originate from [ALRhub/fancy_gym](https://github.com/ALRhub/fancy_gym), distributed under the accompanying MIT LICENSE. Only assets required by this MJCF are included.

The XML is the unchanged asset bound to the released aligned-v2 collection, SHA-256 `67702dc59fd46a039eb708ddc267ff5d1688fa6f175d89b4a73b8f9f0ac3b85d`. The canonical Python environment applies the collection's geometry and physics settings at construction.

Upstream provenance checked at `da1bced0181ced8267247779c001509a2fc94635`; the upstream XML SHA-256 is `67702dc59fd46a039eb708ddc267ff5d1688fa6f175d89b4a73b8f9f0ac3b85d`. The local bound XML hash above identifies the actual asset used here.
